{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Parallel repetitive-control branches","Branch input gains","Positive feedback summation","Complex phase rotations","Exact time delays","Branch-output summation"],"inputs":["e(t): sole external input e(s) in the drawing"],"states":["h_i(t,sigma)"],"outputs":["c(t): the summed external output c(s)"],"differential_equations":["partial(h_i)/partial(t)=partial(h_i)/partial(sigma), -tau<sigma<0, i=0,...,n-1"],"algebraic_equations":["tau=T_o/n; a_i=exp(j*2*pi*i/n), j^2=-1","v_i(t)=h_i(t,-tau)","w_i(t)=a_i*(k_i*e(t)+v_i(t))","h_i(t,0)=w_i(t), i=0,...,n-1 (transport boundary condition)","c(t)=sum(v_i(t), i=0,...,n-1)","For t>=t0+tau: v_i(t)=a_i*(k_i*e(t-tau)+v_i(t-tau)); for t0<=t<t0+tau use v_i(t)=phi_i(t-t0-tau) from initial w_i history phi_i(sigma)=h_i(t0,sigma)","For zero initial histories only: C(s)/E(s)=sum(k_i*a_i*exp(-s*tau)/(1-a_i*exp(-s*tau)), i=0,...,n-1)"],"notes":"n is a positive integer branch count, T_o>0 the period parameter, tau=T_o/n the exact delay, and k_i fixed gains. a_i=exp(j*2*pi*i/n), with j^2=-1, is a complex branch rotation. h_i(t,sigma)=w_i(t+sigma) is a function-valued history on [-tau,0), not a scalar state. Supply initial histories phi_i; continuous compatible initialization satisfies phi_i(0)=a_i*(k_i*e(t0)+phi_i(-tau)). The first delay interval uses these histories directly. v_i is a delayed tap, w_i the boundary signal, and c their sum. The equations contain exact transport PDEs; complex outputs are not restricted to real values."}

From original memories x_I, x_aw and x_D, initialize eta[0]=x_I[0]-k_p*k_droop*x_D[0] and mu[0]=B*x_D[0]+C*x_aw[0]. x_aw stores prior limiter mismatch and x_D prior pre-limit current; their initial values are independent. annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.
annotations.fr:

conversations.value:
<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Complete PMSG MSC/GSC three outer PI plus four inner PI controller"],"inputs":["P_s_ref","P_s","V_dc_ref","V_dc","V_PCC_ref","V_PCC","I_s,q","I_s,d","I_g,d","I_g,q","V_PCC,d","V_PCC,q","omega_r","omega_0"],"states":["phi_P","phi_dc","phi_V","phi_sq","phi_sd","phi_gd","phi_gq"],"outputs":["V_s,d","V_s,q","V_g,d","V_g,q"],"differential_equations":["d phi_P/dt=Ki_P*e_P","d phi_dc/dt=Ki_dc*e_dc","d phi_V/dt=Ki_V*e_V","d phi_sq/dt=Ki_sq*e_sq","d phi_sd/dt=Ki_sd*e_sd","d phi_gd/dt=Ki_gd*e_gd","d phi_gq/dt=Ki_gq*e_gq"],"algebraic_equations":["e_P=P_s_ref-P_s; e_dc=V_dc_ref-V_dc; e_V=V_PCC-V_PCC_ref","y_j=phi_j+Kp_j*e_j for each of the seven PI boxes","I_s,q_ref=y_P; I_s,d_ref=0; I_g,d_ref=y_dc; I_g,q_ref=y_V","e_sq=I_s,q-I_s,q_ref; e_sd=I_s,d-I_s,d_ref","e_gd=I_g,d_ref-I_g,d; e_gq=I_g,q_ref-I_g,q","V_s,d=y_sq+omega_r*psi_f-omega_r*L_s,d*I_s,d","V_s,q=y_sd+omega_r*L_s,q*I_s,q","V_g,d=y_gd+V_PCC,d-omega_0*L_g*I_g,q","V_g,q=y_gq+V_PCC,q+omega_0*L_g*I_g,d"],"notes":"phi_j is the integral contribution of an independent continuous parallel PI, with j in {P,dc,V,sq,sd,gd,gq}; Kp_j and Ki_j are its fixed proportional and integral gains. psi_f is magnet flux; L_s,d, L_s,q and L_g are fixed inductance parameters. Initial integral values are unspecified. The selected PIs are unsaturated and have no anti-windup. The MSC q-current loop produces V_s,d and the d-current loop produces V_s,q under the stated axis labels. I_s,d_ref is fixed at zero. Terminal voltages are commands; machine and converter plant dynamics are outside this model."}

请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["IEEG1 steam governor with lead-lag, rate-limited bounded valve and three tapped turbine lags"],"inputs":["Delta_omega","P0","Delta_P_ref_i"],"states":["x1","v","x4","x5","x6"],"outputs":["P_m"],"differential_equations":["d x1/dt=(Delta_omega-x1)/T1","d v/dt=P(v,r;P_min,P_max)","d x4/dt=(v-x4)/T4","d x5/dt=(x4-x5)/T5","d x6/dt=(x5-x6)/T6"],"algebraic_equations":["y_speed=K*((T2/T1)*Delta_omega+(1-T2/T1)*x1)","e=P0+Delta_P_ref_i-y_speed-v","r=min(U_0,max(U_c,e/T3))","P(x,r;l,h)=0 if (x>=h and r>0) or (x<=l and r<0), otherwise r","P_m=K1*x4+K2*x5+K3*x6"],"notes":"x1 is the speed lead-lag denominator state; v is valve position; x4, x5 and x6 are successive turbine-lag outputs. K,T1,T3,T4,T5,T6>0; T2,K1,K2,K3 are fixed parameters. U_c<=0<=U_0 are valve-rate bounds; P_min<P_max are valve-position bounds. P is a limited-integrator rate projection: it suppresses outward motion at a position bound and permits inward motion. Initially v lies in [P_min,P_max]; other initial values are unspecified. r is the separately clipped valve rate. K1,K2,K3 weight the turbine taps without a sum-to-one constraint."}
